name: 20 Watt Monitor Amplifier

pins.quote: The output signal is taken from the junction of R60 and R61 and routed via Ll to the module connector Pl pin 1 The feedback loop for the output stage connects to the same junction.

note: Each pin as a page of its own documents gives it (conf high: RTO-144 sheet or a connector-layout page; medium: rows of a rear-view drawing or a sentence of the manual; low: a schematic call-out; variant: none of its own, read from the variant named). Pins no page names are not listed.
